strings.zh: 月子『我是星期一的月子。{SCROLL}作为与你结交的证明给你这个！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Monica: Glad to meet you. I’m Monica{NEWLINE}of Monday.{SCROLL}As a token of our friendship, I have a{NEWLINE}gift for you!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 月子『这是提升飞行系{NEWLINE}攻击力的道具。{SCROLL}给你的鸟精灵带吧！
strings.en: Monica: It’s an item that raises the{NEWLINE}power of Flying-type moves.{SCROLL}You should equip a bird Pokémon with{NEWLINE}that item.

strings.zh: 月子『我的弟弟妹妹{NEWLINE}遍布各个不同的地方。{SCROLL}去找找看吧！
strings.en: Monica: My brothers and sisters are all{NEWLINE}over the place.{SCROLL}See if you could find them all!

strings.zh: 月子『哎呀,不行哦！{NEWLINE}今天可不是星期一啊！{SCROLL}下次再来吧！
strings.en: Monica: Oh no! Today isn’t Monday.{NEWLINE}See you another time!

strings.zh: 火子『我是星期二的火子。{SCROLL}作为寒暄礼请收下这个吧{SCROLL}
strings.en: Tuscany: I am Tuscany of Tuesday.{SCROLL}Please accept this as a token of{NEWLINE}greeting.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 火子『你一定觉得这汤匙{NEWLINE}形状很奇怪吧？{SCROLL}这是能加强超能力{NEWLINE}技能威力的道具。{CLEAR}我想你一定用得上的。
strings.en: Tuscany: You must think this spoon has{NEWLINE}a strange shape, do you not?{SCROLL}It is an item that powers up{NEWLINE}Psychic-type moves.{CLEAR}I am sure you will find it useful.

strings.zh: 火子『你见过月子姐姐了吗？{CLEAR}水男呢？{SCROLL}我是七兄妹中的第二个。
strings.en: Tuscany: Have you met Monica, my older{NEWLINE}sister?{SCROLL}Or my younger brother, Wesley?{SCROLL}I am the second of seven children.

strings.zh: 火子『星期二{NEWLINE}很快就结束了呢⋯⋯{SCROLL}下一个星期二再来吧⋯⋯
strings.en: Tuscany: Tuesday was over before I{NEWLINE}even noticed...{SCROLL}I’ll see you again next Tuesday...

strings.zh: 水雄『我是星期三的水雄！{SCROLL}我们能见面也是{NEWLINE}缘分啊,这个送你！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Wesley: I’m Wesley of Wednesday!{SCROLL}Meeting you must be fate. This is for{NEWLINE}you!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 水雄男『这个黑带{NEWLINE}能提升格斗系技能的威力！
strings.en: Wesley: This Black Belt powers up{NEWLINE}Fighting-type moves!
strings.notes: speaker label in zh is 水雄男 (typo for 水雄, Wesley)

strings.zh: 水雄『你能找到我,{NEWLINE}就是说你已经见过了{CLEAR}我那些姐姐们了吗？{SCROLL}还是说只是单纯的运气好呢？
strings.en: Wesley: Since you found me, does that{NEWLINE}mean you’ve already met my big sisters?{SCROLL}Or did you just get lucky?

strings.zh: 水雄『糟糕了！{NEWLINE}星期三已经结束啦！{CLEAR}下次再来吧！
strings.en: Wesley: No way!{NEWLINE}Wednesday’s already over!{CLEAR}See you next week!

strings.zh: 木雄『你是谁？{SCROLL}我是星期四的木雄,{SCROLL}这个送你！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Arthur: Who are you?{SCROLL}I’m Arthur of Thursday.{SCROLL}Here, take this!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 木雄『把这给能使用岩石系{NEWLINE}技能的精灵吧,{SCROLL}它能提升岩石系技能的威力。
strings.en: Arthur: If you use Rock-type moves,{NEWLINE}you should give that to your Pokémon.{SCROLL}It raises the strength of{NEWLINE}Rock-type moves.

strings.zh: 木雄『我是星期四的木雄！{CLEAR}七兄妹中的次男！
strings.en: Arthur: I’m Arthur of Thursday!{NEWLINE}I’m the second son{CLEAR}in a line of seven siblings!
strings.notes: US 0752/14; layout rebalance 2026-10-09 (prompt icons / single-word page)

strings.zh: 木雄『你觉得一个星期的{NEWLINE}正中是星期三呢,{CLEAR}还是星期四呢？{SCROLL}不管怎么说,{NEWLINE}下个星期四再见吧！
strings.en: Arthur: Do you think that the middle of{NEWLINE}the week is Wednesday?{CLEAR}Or do you think it’s Thursday?{SCROLL}Either way, I’ll see you{NEWLINE}next Thursday!
strings.notes: US 0752/15 | RV085: addition: 不管怎么说 = either way; dropped invented 'Go decide'

strings.zh: 金子『呀哈~！{SCROLL}我是星期五的金子！{NEWLINE}多多关照啊！{SCROLL}送你毒针吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Frieda: Yahoo!{SCROLL}I’m Frieda of Friday!{NEWLINE}Nice to meet you!{SCROLL}Here’s a Poison Barb for you!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 金子『给会毒系技能的{NEWLINE}精灵带上吧！{SCROLL}你就会惊奇地发现{SCROLL}它的毒系技能威力提升了！
strings.en: Frieda: Give it to a Pokémon that knows{NEWLINE}Poison-type moves!{SCROLL}You’ll be amazed to find its{NEWLINE}Poison-type moves got stronger!

strings.zh: 金子『你好你好！{NEWLINE}你最喜欢星期几呢？{SCROLL}我喜欢星期五！{NEWLINE}绝对的！{SCROLL}你也这么想吧？
strings.en: Frieda: Hiya! What day do you like?{SCROLL}I love Friday. No doubt about it!{SCROLL}Don’t you think it’s great too?

strings.zh: 金子『哎？{NEWLINE}今天不是星期五？{SCROLL}真希望每一天都是星期五啊！
strings.en: Frieda: Oh, today’s not Friday?{SCROLL}I really wish every day were Friday!
strings.notes: US 0752/19 | RV085: addition: dropped invented 'Man...' and 'that’d be so much fun'

strings.zh: 土雄『⋯⋯　⋯⋯　⋯⋯{SCROLL}我是星期六的土雄⋯⋯{SCROLL}这个送你⋯⋯{SCROLL}
strings.en: Santos: ...{SCROLL}I’m Santos of Saturday...{SCROLL}This is for you...{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 土雄『⋯⋯　⋯⋯　⋯⋯{SCROLL}这个⋯⋯{SCROLL}能够提升地面系技能的威力,{NEWLINE}足以吓你一跳⋯⋯
strings.en: Santos: ...{SCROLL}This...{SCROLL}It powers up Ground-type moves...{NEWLINE}Enough to startle you...

strings.zh: 土雄『⋯⋯　⋯⋯　⋯⋯{SCROLL}下个礼拜六再见吧⋯⋯
strings.en: Santos: ...{SCROLL}See you again on another Saturday...

strings.zh: 土雄『今天是星期六⋯⋯{NEWLINE}才⋯⋯怪⋯⋯{SCROLL}那么下个星期六再见吧⋯⋯
strings.en: Santos: Today’s Saturday...{NEWLINE}...Not...{SCROLL}I’ll see you next Saturday then...
strings.notes: US 0752/23 | RV085: meaning: 才怪 is a deadpan denial, not confusion (D-2026)

strings.zh: 日雄『我是星期日的日雄！{SCROLL}有人让我看到你就把这{NEWLINE}东西给你！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Sunny: I’m Sunny of Sunday!{SCROLL}Somebody told me to give you this if I{NEWLINE}saw you!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 日雄『这个是{SCROLL}那个什么⋯⋯{SCROLL}⋯⋯什么来着？{SCROLL}⋯⋯　⋯⋯　⋯⋯{SCROLL}啊！{NEWLINE}想起来了！{SCROLL}让会电系技能的精灵拿着{CLEAR}就能提升电系技能威力！{CLEAR}月子姐姐是这么说的！
strings.en: Sunny: That thing...{SCROLL}Um...{SCROLL}...What was it now...{SCROLL}...{SCROLL}Oh! I remember now!{SCROLL}A Pokémon that knows Electric-type{NEWLINE}moves should hold it.{SCROLL}My sis Monica said it powers up{NEWLINE}Electric-type moves!

strings.zh: 日雄『月子姐姐和{NEWLINE}火子姐姐和{CLEAR}水雄哥哥和{CLEAR}木雄哥哥和{CLEAR}金子姐姐和{CLEAR}土雄哥哥！{SCROLL}我是最小的一个！
strings.en: Sunny: Sister Monica, and{NEWLINE}sister Tuscany, and{CLEAR}brother Wesley, and{CLEAR}brother Arthur, and{CLEAR}sister Frieda, and{CLEAR}brother Santos!{SCROLL}I’m the youngest!

strings.zh: 日雄『哎？{NEWLINE}今天不是星期天？{CLEAR}唔⋯⋯忘了！
strings.en: Sunny: Huh? Isn’t today Sunday?{NEWLINE}Um... I forgot!

strings.zh: 月子『哎呀,你就是{NEWLINE}找到了我们所有{CLEAR}兄弟姐妹的人吧！{SCROLL}我们已经完全成朋友了,{SCROLL}作为朋友的纪念给你{NEWLINE}惹事缎带吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Monica: Oh my, you’re the one who found{NEWLINE}all of my siblings, aren’t you!{SCROLL}We’re true friends now!{SCROLL}As a token of our friendship, I’ll give{NEWLINE}you this Alert Ribbon!{SCROLL}
